text:
Nina K.: Hey — company card declined at hotel check-in in Lisbon. Front desk says authorization failure. Had pre-approved hotel via travel booking. Anyone know who to call? Can I pay personally and submit reimbursement? Also partner stayed one night, separate charges on room. :grimacing:

Ella (People Ops): @Nina K. sorry about that. Yes, pay personally if card fails at check-in. Keep itemized receipt and the folio showing room/incidentals. Submit via Ramp within 7 days. For partner/guest charges, those are non-reimbursable unless pre-approved. Did you get the folio?

Nina K.: Got folio screenshot. Guest charge is listed as 'additional guest'. I paid €180 for 1 night (card declined for deposit).

Ben - Travel Ops: If it was a deposit hold that failed, sometimes hotels accept a cash/debit. For reimbursement, we need the hotel folio plus a boarding pass or itinerary for the trip. Also copy of the failed authorization screenshot helps. Share receipts in Ramp and tag 'travel + lodging'.

Sam (Finance): @Nina K. you can file as 'Lodging - Emergency charge'. Use expense code EXP-LODG-TRV. We'll process same-day if flagged urgent, otherwise standard 3-5 business days after submission + approval. If you need immediate cash back, we can advance via Ramp virtual card - ping me.

Travel Bot: Reminder: per policy, partner/guest accommodation is not reimbursable unless 'business guest' was pre-authorized. See https://redwood.com/policies/travel for exceptions.

Maria: Also double-check foreign transaction fees — we reimburse FX fees if using company card or for emergency personal payment (attach bank statement).

Nina K.: Thanks — submitted Ramp expense 176800A with folio and CC decline screenshot. Marked urgent.

Sam (Finance): Received. I'll push it through and notify once issued. @Ella (People Ops) for note that this one included guest fee — manual approval required.

Ella (People Ops): Noted. If @Nina K. can provide short justification why guest stayed (client dinner), include in comments. We'll approve if aligned.

Nina K.: Guest was spouse, not client — understood non-reimbursable. I've split the receipt and requested reimbursement only for room portion. Thanks.

Ben - Travel Ops: Small tip — next time set pre-authorization limit to €300 in booking notes for EU hotels to avoid declines.

Sam (Finance): Quick how-to for Ramp: attach folio, use category Lodging, set payment method 'personal card - reimbursement', enter bank acct last 4, and mark 'urgent' in notes. Example:

```
Category: Lodging
Expense Code: EXP-LODG-TRV
Attachments: folio.pdf, card_decline.png
Notes: paid personally due to company card auth failure; request urgent reimbursement
```

Travel Bot: Expense submitted after 7 days may be denied per policy. :warning:

Nina K.: All done, thanks everyone :raised_hands:
